title: No Knead Bread | Bread Recipe | The New York Times
summary: Mark Bittman and baker Jim Lahey of Sullivan Street Bakery demonstrate the no-knead bread recipe, where a long, slow rise does the work instead of kneading. It is a short New York Times recipe video.
why: HN people point to it as a cheap, low-effort way to bake very good bread and as a beginner step into cooking.

quote.text: it takes 5 minutes of effort and about 40 cents to make very good bread out of salt, flour, yeast and water.
